LEGISLATIVE HISTORY
16. M. Ordinance 7 of 1948 — Interpretation and General Clauses
                             Ordinance, 1948
     Commencement                    :        31 January 1948
     Application                     :        16 September 1963
     Note: This Ordinance had effect in Singapore for the interpretation of the
           laws of the Federation specified in the First Schedule to the
           Modification of Laws (Internal Security and Public Order)
           (Singapore) Order, 1963 (L.N. 231/1963 (G.N. Sp. No. S 4/1963)),
           with effect from 16 September 1963.
